title: CRESiST: Self-Enhancing Explorative Policy Learning for Simultaneous Speech Translation
abstract: arXiv:2611.06501v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Simultaneous Speech Translation (SimulST) requires balancing translation quality and latency. While Large Language Models (LLMs) excel in offline translation, current LLM-based SimulST systems predominantly rely on prefix-incremental generation. This paradigm suffers from redundant Key-Value cache recomputation and necessitates external Voice Activity Detection to process unbounded streams. To overcome these bottlenecks, we propose an end-to-end interleaved read-write framework built upon an omni-modal LLM. By interleaving speech chunks and text tokens, our architecture achieves full KV cache reuse, natively supporting segmentation-free, infinite-length inference. Furthermore, to learn optimal streaming policies without rigid offline alignments, we introduce a novel Actor-Critic self-enhancement pipeline. translated_title: CRESiST：面向同声传译的自增强探索性策略学习
translated_abstract: 同声传译需要在翻译质量与延迟之间取得平衡。虽然大语言模型（LLM）在离线翻译中表现出色，但当前基于LLM的同声传译系统主要依赖前缀增量生成范式。这种范式存在键值缓存冗余重复计算的问题，并且需要借助外部语音活动检测（VAD）来处理无界音频流。为克服这些瓶颈，我们提出了一种构建在全模态LLM之上的端到端读写交错框架。通过将语音块与文本token交错排列，我们的架构实现了KV缓存的完全复用，原生支持无需分段、无限长度的推理。此外，为了在没有严格离线对齐的条件下学习最优流式策略，我们引入了一种新颖的Actor-Critic自增强流水线：RNN-T执行者动态采样读写轨迹，而基于LLM的评论者通过内在语义和……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出CRESiST框架，通过基于全模态大模型的端到端语音与文本读写交错架构实现KV缓存完全复用、原生支持无限长流式同声传译，并借助RNN-T执行者与LLM评论者构成的自增强策略学习管线在无需离线对齐的情况下优化读写决策。
en_tdlr: CRESiST introduces an end-to-end interleaved read-write framework built on an omni-modal LLM that enables full KV cache reuse for segmentation-free, infinite-length simultaneous speech translation, together with a novel Actor-Critic self-enhancement pipeline where an RNN-T Actor samples read-write trajectories evaluated by an LLM-based Critic.
